from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path.cwd(); stage=root/'logs/v0.2.1'; stage.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
old=json.loads((root/'logs/v0.1.3/input_hashes.json').read_text())
paths={Path(p) for p in old}
paths.update((root/'LeanPML').rglob('*.lean'))
# 新模块尚非旧文件；只保护本轮开始前已有的 v0.1 文件。
paths={p for p in paths if p.name not in {'Coefficients.lean','Weights.lean'}}
paths.update(p for p in (root/'docs').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
paths.update(p for d in ['v0.0.3','v0.1.1','v0.1.2','v0.1.3'] for p in (root/'logs'/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
paths.add(root.parent/'results/V7_Maxwell_Debye_PML/V7_global_energy.md')
hashes={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(paths)}
(stage/'input_hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
for name in ['README.md','PROGRESS.md','LeanPML.lean','Audit.lean','ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md']:
 (stage/('before_'+name)).write_bytes((root/name).read_bytes())
diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md'],text=True)
(stage/'roadmap_preexisting_diff.patch').write_text(diff)
print('Protected input files:',len(hashes))
print('V7 SHA256:', hashes[str(root.parent/'results/V7_Maxwell_Debye_PML/V7_global_energy.md')])
print('Roadmap SHA256:',hashes[str(root/'ROADMAP_lean_PML_revised.md')])
print('Preexisting roadmap diff:\n'+diff)
